messages:
jess (PM): quick huddle — we need a tight, testable launch plan for the Optimize Advisor (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). customers want clearer gates and an admin UX.
lee (Eng): +1. we should split features into MUST ship (recommendation engine + alerting) vs MAYBE (auto-apply, multi-model quant workflows).
sam (ML): must-have signal set: token_savings_est, delta_eval_score (AUC or accuracy), p50/p95 latency change, and a confidence score for quant suggestions. without confidence we can't auto-recommend.
gabriela (Design): admin flow note: customers asked for a "why" card per recommendation (short reasoning + sample diff). also an accept/reject with override note. keep it compact.
kai (SRE): rollout constraints: hosted vs dedicated differences. For hosted, we can roll at route-level with gradual ramp. For Dedicated, need node-level canaries and a forced fallback path to baseline model. add an ops emergency off switch.
jess (PM): propose launch gates draft: 1) pilot customers (>=2) have validated token_savings >= 6% on baseline; 2) no critical eval regressions > 2% on customer-critical prompts; 3) p95 latency regression <= 25ms for interactive endpoints; 4) alerting is wired to #prod-evals + webhook for customer SREs. feedback?
sam (ML): suggest tightening gate 2 for financial customers: no regression >1% on critical prompts. also require nightly eval runs with historical diff dashboard.
lee (Eng): engineering asks: define pilot matrix (customer x model x mode x seq_len_bucket). we need that to estimate batching impact and memory pressure. I'll make a template.
gabriela (Design): for the diff preview, mock idea: side-by-side tokenized example + highlighted changes + cost delta. small teaser link: https://figma.com/s/opt-advisor-diff (will share real link later).
ops-bot: created ticket OPT-1245: "Optimize Advisor launch gates" assigned to jess, lee, sam, kai. checklist: pilot matrix, eval harness, canary runbook, admin mocks.
jess (PM): on alerts — what should trigger an eval alert? single-run regression above threshold? sustained degradation? need concrete rulebook.
sam (ML): rulebook proposal: level=warning if single-run delta > 1.5x baseline threshold, level=critical if delta > 2x or repeated 3/night. notify #prod-evals and trigger customer webhook for critical. store payload for auditing.
kai (SRE): add circuit-breaker conditions: 1) sustained p95 > SLO for 10m, 2) error rate jump > 2x baseline for 5m. circuit trips -> automatic rollback to baseline and page on-call.
lee (Eng): operational knobs: per-customer "optimize:enabled" flag, per-route opt-out, and "latency-first" profile that opts out of batching for interactive routes. implement as config with dynamic reload.
gabriela (Design): admin page should show current profile, last eval snapshot, and a one-click revert. small inline help to explain economic tradeoffs.
jess (PM): timeline: aim for pilot readiness in 3 weeks (matrix + eval harness + mocks), canary in 5 weeks, GA in 9 weeks if gates pass. is that realistic?
lee (Eng): 3 weeks is tight but doable for minimal recommender + alerts. quant recommendation validation and quality checks may slip to Q2 if needed.
sam (ML): I'll deliver a minimal eval harness (nightly runs, diff storage, webhook for alerts) in 2 weeks. need access to pilot prompts and baseline model snapshots.
kai (SRE): I'll draft canary runbook and circuit-breaker automation this week. need confirmation on Dedicated quotas for pilots.
jess (PM): next steps: lee create pilot matrix template, sam request pilot datasets and baseline snapshots, kai draft canary runbook, gabriela produce compact mocks. sync next Tue 10:00 PT to review readiness. If anyone hits blockers, post here.
gabriela (Design): noted. will post 2 screens by tomorrow. :thumbsup:
lee (Eng): will start matrix now, tagging jess when ready.
sam (ML): pinging FinAcct contact for prompt set.
jess (PM): thanks team — keep scope tight. we'll defer auto-apply and advanced quant flows to follow-up release. :rocket:
